justification: `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/function/IORunnable.java` is a small 56-line `@FunctionalInterface` with one abstract method (`run()`), one default adapter (`asRunnable()`), and one static factory (`noop()`); it models a single concern: a `Runnable` that can throw `IOException`. `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/function/IORunnableTest.java` covers only those three behaviors, and there is no evidence of multiple responsibilities or a need to split the class into smaller abstractions.
